Ada Lovelace was an English mathematician and writer, chiefly known for her work on Charles Babbage's proposed mechanical general-purpose computer, the Analytical Engine.[1]

Biography

Childhood

Lovelace was born on 10 December 1815, the only child of the poet Lord Byron and Anne Isabella Milbanke.

Adult years

In 1835 she married William King.

Legacy

Ada Lovelace Day is celebrated on the second Tuesday of October.

The math B8B_8 appears in her notes.
